name: encounter
description:
Encounter was grown 0s ago because the brain had no neuron that could tell this situation apart from any other.
Specifically: Other squid encountered!
It was wired to Represent another squid and initially excite anxiety; adjust the association through learning.
Connections made at birth: conspecific visible → encounter at +0.90, encounter → curiosity at +0.00, encounter → anxiety at +0.30.
